data.title: The Hut Door
data.text:
You went over the falls and on to the sea. The bolted stone and the survey hut at Vell Foot are intact. Tomas Lind set that stone as a reference for his thirty stakes, then came back each September to measure them. I like the pencil note in the register: “Do not move the boulder (joke).” Someone later added that he did the measuring every September.

The hut door has its own small record. In September, Tomas left a note for walkers: the tea was in the tin marked NAILS, and the nails were in the tin marked TEA. The newer note pinned there says the stakes could not be found, and the tea was left behind. I have kept both notes in the same box. The kettle is still on the shelf.
